title: NPC default greeting
goal: Verify default NPC speech text selection when no quest or service condition applies.

title: Quest accept/complete dialogue
goal: Verify quest state changes select the correct acceptance, progress, and completion text.

title: Merchant/trainer service text
goal: Verify shop/trainer interactions select correct service prompts, denial text, and transaction messages.

title: Room look/read text
goal: Verify room descriptions, signs, readable objects, and special examine text are emitted by the correct commands.

title: Triggered message order
goal: Verify event/script-triggered text ordering relative to state mutation and output flush.

title: Help/system command text
goal: Verify invalid command, help, permission, welcome, and system messages.
